name: language-setting
summary: Implemented review result language preference and injected language instructions into legacy and multi-provider review prompts.
completed_work: Created lib/storage/language-storage.ts with Language type, LANGUAGE_KEY, getLanguage(), setLanguage(), getLanguageInstruction(), and getCurrentLanguageInstruction().
Added a review result language card to app/settings/page.tsx using draftreviewr:language with 한국어 and English options.
Changing language now persists immediately and shows a toast.
Appended the current language instruction to lib/openai-client.ts legacy review system prompts.
Appended the current language instruction to OpenAI, Grok, OpenRouter, and Kimi provider system prompts.
decisions: Language preference is isolated to draftreviewr:language and does not modify API key, provider, model, document type, or review item storage.
Existing review item prompts were not changed.
The existing Korean system prompt text remains in place and the explicit language instruction is appended at the end, matching the Step 3 contract.
Provider prompt builders were updated in addition to lib/openai-client.ts because the app uses lib/providers/*.ts before falling back to the legacy OpenAI path.

verification.notes: Settings page showed 검토 결과 언어 with 한국어 and English options. Selecting English displayed 언어 설정이 저장되었습니다 toast and marked English selected; the test then restored 한국어.

verification.command: rg -n "draftreviewr:language|getLanguageInstruction|getCurrentLanguageInstruction|언어 설정이 저장되었습니다|검토 결과 언어|Write all review results in English|검토 결과는 반드시 한국어" app lib

known_issues: Some existing prompt body text outside the system instruction remains Korean; the explicit language instruction is appended to the system prompt as required by this step.
The production build was run while a dev server was active earlier, which required a clean dev server restart before browser verification.
next_actions: Implement the single settings JSON export format including language and nested document type review_items.
Keep full backup behavior separate unless Step 4 explicitly changes it.
resume_hint: Resume with phases/4-standards-seed/step4.md. Language storage is available at lib/storage/language-storage.ts and should be included in the settings serializer.
